messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 paging — increased tail latency observed in router path (p99 spike, streaming stalls). Auto-escalation triggered. see https://telemetry/redwood/incidents/1718004321 :exclamation:
anya (oncall): I’m on it. grabbing bridge. starting triage — what’s the visible impact?
mike_routing: p95 ~ 180ms -> 400ms, p99 jumping from 800ms -> 3.6s for streaming sessions in eu-west-2. ingest/egress ok, looks like misrouting to overloaded shards.
leo_sre: seeing repeated 503->retry loops in router logs, and loadbalancer shows hot shard in zone-a. heatmap attached in telemetry (link above).
jamie_prodeng: any customer visible errors? support?
ingrid_support: two customers reported streaming stalls and slow chat responses, one reported reconnects. CS is triaging and notified customers with preliminary statement.
anya (oncall): immediate mitigation options? can we fallback routing or reduce weight to zone-a?
mike_routing: we have a rollout of new weight policy earlier today — might be flipping affinity logic. current rollout id rwght-2026-03-15-09. rollback possible but takes ~5m to propagate.
leo_sre: alternative — emergency hotkey-ejection: eject hot shard from LB for 2m to let it drain. requires oncall approval.
anya (oncall): approve eject for 2m, do it. jamie, coordinate fallback alerting.
jamie_prodeng: ack. notifying infra. also enabling aggressive KV-prefix cache for affected models to reduce backend load.
mike_routing: eject command issued: `rbctl eject-shard --shard zone-a-37 --duration 120s`
pagerduty-bot: Action logged by anya (oncall) at 1718004480 — eject-shard executed.
leo_sre: after eject we see p99 drop from 3.6s -> 950ms within 45s. streaming stalls reduced but not eliminated. tail still elevated.
anya (oncall): partial mitigation good. we need root cause: is it policy bug or hot partition?
mike_routing: early signs point to policy bug: new weight selection can bias by recent load and created a feedback loop where popular keys kept being routed back to the same physical shard (hothash). I’m pulling logs to confirm.
leo_sre: also note cross-zone affinity metrics show region-skew for eu-west-2 toward zone-a, while eu-west-1 unaffected.
ingrid_support: customer impact: three active sessions timed out; affected apps saw transient stalls. CS will follow up.
jamie_prodeng: recommendation: pause weight rollout and deploy a fix to selection to include jitter + eviction TTL. rolling rollout blocked.
mike_routing: I’ll pause rollout (rwght-2026-03-15-09) now: `rollout pause rwght-2026-03-15-09`
pagerduty-bot: Rollout pause executed by mike_routing at 1718004575.
leo_sre: takingsaved routing table snapshot for postmortem: `tbctl snapshot --tag incident-1718004321`
anya (oncall): telemetry task — capture sample traces for p99 requests and attach stack traces and KV cache hit rates.
jamie_prodeng: pushing small config patch to add jitter to selection (non-blocking) to test in canary; will monitor for 10m.
mike_routing: patch deployed to canary. initial canary shows stable distribution.
leo_sre: running streaming restarts on a couple of overloaded endpoints to clear internal queues. will coordinate 1 at a time.
anya (oncall): timecheck: 12m since first page. current customer-visible error rate down 70%. p99 ~ 820ms.
ingrid_support: issuing customer follow-up note: "We've mitigated a routing event causing stalls, engineering investigating root cause. We'll update in 60m"
jamie_prodeng: if canary holds for 10m we can promote fix and continue rollback policy. recommend deploy after 10m.
mike_routing: canary looks good at 9m. promoting to 25% traffic.
leo_sre: watchlist — eviction thresholds, hotkey cache TTL, and LB backpressure metrics. set alert to 10% above baseline.
anya (oncall): handoff to night oncall (leo_sre) in 30m. I'll prepare short summary for bridge notes.
anya (oncall): summary for handoff: incident-1718004321 — root cause likely weight-selection feedback (hothash) during rollout rwght-2026-03-15-09 causing zone-a hot partition and router misroutes; partial mitigation via shard-eject and rollout pause; canary patch with jitter deployed and promoted to 25%; customer impact: streaming stalls and reconnects for a subset of sessions, CS notified. next steps: promote fix to 100% if metrics stable; prepare postmortem.
leo_sre: got it. I’ll own overnight monitoring and the postmortem doc. tagging owners: @mike_routing for fix, @jamie_prodeng for rollout gating, @ingrid_support for customer comms.
jamie_prodeng: adding action items to console: create rollback runbook, add preflight checks for weight policies, add synthetic tests for hotkey distribution.
ingrid_support: will keep customers updated.
anya (oncall): thanks team. closing live bridge in 8m, will re-open if p99 > 1.2s or error rate > 3x baseline. :white_check_mark:
leo_sre: closing notes — logs uploaded to /incidents/1718004321/artifacts, saved heap snapshots and routing table.
incident-bot: Incident updated to MONITOR state at 1718005221.
